milestones.title: Provider-independent static workspace host and product-boundary documentation
milestones.summary: Dependency-free Node.js 22 loopback host for the existing static landing page and encrypted-package browser workspace, with an explicit route allowlist, restrictive browser headers, read-only methods, removal of the Vercel analytics dependency, and documented separation from Project Genesis.

verification.testScope: Six focused standalone-host test cases are present in the merged source. The observed Candidate verification job log ran only the focused Direct Pipe test, so no CI execution of the new standalone-host suite is asserted.
verification.mergeWorkflowObservation: Direct repository Actions enumeration without a PR-event filter confirms 4 successful push-triggered workflows on merge commit 66a7610f324ad56bf84b674f7e3f502a744a7532.
unresolvedReviewFindings: Non-loopback HTTP browser use is not a secure context, so Web Crypto seal/open operations require HTTPS.
The /healthz endpoint reports process liveness without confirming required static assets are readable.

previousMergeWorkflowObservation.text: The PR-filtered workflow lookup returned no GitHub Actions runs for the merge SHA. A Vercel commit status reported success, but no external production smoke test was verified.

verification.mergeTestScope: The post-merge Candidate Node job executed only test/direct-pipe-runtime.v1.test.mjs (1 pass, 0 fail). Execution of test/standalone-host.test.mjs at this merge remains unverified.

limitations: Static web service only; it does not launch the native distributed protocol, deliver packages, activate Port Zero, establish physical zero-copy, or expose an authenticated public API.
Local loopback operation avoids a hosting-provider dependency but still requires a machine and Node.js 22 or newer.
LAN encrypted-workspace use requires separately administered HTTPS; direct public Internet exposure is not supported.
The merged standalone-host test source was inspected, but its execution was not observed in the fetched source-head CI logs.
No externally verified production deployment, global access, customer use, revenue, or worldwide-priority claim is established.

milestones.title: PORT/1 signed native addressing, offline resolution and INTERCONNECT integration
milestones.summary: Local self-certifying port:// overlay with Ed25519-signed namespace manifests, aliases and subdomains; offline resolution; INTERCONNECT display after Node-based verification; and an opt-in user-scoped Windows protocol handler.

verification.testScope: The INTERCONNECT workflow executed 11 Python tests, including both new signed port-address integration tests, and passed. Seven new Node test cases are present in the merged source, but their execution was not established in the fetched workflow logs. Candidate verification also passed 60 general Python tests.
verification.mergeWorkflowObservation: Direct repository Actions enumeration without a PR-event filter confirms 4 successful push-triggered workflows on merge commit fce0cb25e13ea26c55e2d5be4defd63c74d19242.
unresolvedReviewFindings: The exposed resolver does not persist or use SignedPortNameDirectory state, so rollback and issuer-revocation protection is not enforced through the activation path.
Namespace initialization is not transactional after private-key creation; a later manifest-write failure can require manual repair.
INTERCONNECT Back, Forward and Reload can reuse cached synthetic HTML without re-verifying signature, expiry or bindings.
The writer limits canonical manifest bytes while readers limit the pretty-printed signed envelope, so near-limit valid writes can become unreadable or unrenewable.

previousMergeWorkflowObservation.text: The fetched successful runs were associated with PR #29 source head and checked out GitHub's synthesized PR merge ref. No distinct post-merge workflow execution on merge commit fce0cb25e13ea26c55e2d5be4defd63c74d19242 is asserted. A Vercel status was successful, but no production deployment or public-service smoke test was verified.

verification.mergeTestScope: The post-merge Candidate Node job executed only test/direct-pipe-runtime.v1.test.mjs (1 pass, 0 fail). Execution of the new signed-address Node test suite at this merge remains unverified.

limitations: This is a custom local overlay, not IANA registration, an ICANN top-level domain, public DNS delegation or a normal-browser HTTPS replacement.
Initial names are signed reservations, not live applications; the merge does not establish a live carrier, production service, remote access authorization or public deployment.
A signed name does not itself grant transport or data access, establish legal title or monopoly, or prove Internet-domain registration ownership.
The exposed activation path does not enforce the implementation's rollback and issuer-revocation state, and three additional review findings remained unresolved at merge.
No customers, revenue, independent recognition, production benchmark or worldwide-priority claim is established.
